request.prompt: Create exactly one isolated full-body Praetorian from the original Mass Effect 2. Reference 1, the actual in-game combat screenshot, controls the open-head state, angle, pose, complete silhouette, colors and emission. Reference 2, the extracted game-model preview, only corroborates mechanical anatomy, joints, cable connections and complete extremities; do not substitute its closed-head pose or unlit eyes. Reproduce the same floating three-quarter view, with the large raised angular top shell, four bright blue-white optics, pointed central beak, the existing recessed cluster of small organic faces within the open center, the dark layered body, the connected hanging cables and the FOUR long bent mechanical limbs ending in their sharp points. Match the source's dark charcoal/bronze surfaces, limb asymmetry, panel silhouettes and proportions exactly. This is a single fictional game creature, not multiple separate characters. Preserve the source game-model level of detail without adding gore, wounds, fluid, extra faces, limbs, armor, weapons or decorative elements. Keep the entire top crest and all four limb tips fully within the frame, with at least 10 percent clear transparent margin on every side. Remove the buildings, sky, floor, floor shadow and the broad surrounding barrier aura; retain only the four contained optic lights and the small blue interior light that belongs inside the shell. No diffuse glow cloud outside the silhouette, no glowing outline or background color. All space outside the creature and its narrow cables is fully transparent with real alpha. One subject, one view, no pedestal, text, border, sheet or collage. Keep the source's pose and perspective so no new hidden side is invented.

notes: Deux références inspectées : capture finale ouverte entière, preview du modèle fermé entier pour connexions.
Pose et émission viennent exclusivement de la capture Combat; la planche fermée est complémentaire.
Quatre pointes présentes; états fermés/ouvertures, détails organiques masqués et matériaux moteur non certifiés.
